name: Neha (Nevi) Chaudhari

project.name: herClaw
project.tagline: A personal AI agent with her own email and phone, in one Docker command.
project.description: herClaw is a hardened, one-command install of OpenClaw wired to Inkbox for real-world comms. The goal is distribution to nontechnical users — the 90% who want an assistant but don't have API keys or GitHub accounts. Same agent identity across email today, Telegram and voice next, with persistent memory and an on-device workspace so conversations never leave the user's machine.

highlights: Fixed 3 real distribution-readiness bugs during the hackathon: startup race on `openclaw doctor --fix` (npm install hung the gateway), DNS pinned to 1.1.1.1/8.8.8.8 broke on networks that block UDP-53 to public resolvers, default OpenAI model swapped to gpt-4o-mini for tier-1 rate-limit headroom.
End-to-end email round-trip working live: iPhone Mail → Inkbox webhook → OpenClaw agent → reply arrives in sender's inbox in ~15 seconds.
Hardened Docker posture: all Linux capabilities dropped, no-new-privileges, file perms 700/600, CPU/memory/PID/log-size limits, host-DNS resolver for privacy.
Built for nontechnical, security-conscious users — the underserved audience in consumer AI.
